# Stereo VRS 0.2.0 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** Use superpowers:executing-plans with independent
> launcher and gaze-helper tasks dispatched via dispatching-parallel-agents.

**Goal:** Package 0.2.0 with all 0.1.2 features and experimental stereo VRS.
**Architecture:** Native stereo XR passthrough, bounded NVAPI world-sort scopes,
per-eye foveation map and optional isolated gaze input. Quad stays unchanged.
**Tech Stack:** C++17, D3D11/NVAPI, OpenXR, .NET Framework WinForms.
**Spec:** ../specs/2026-11-02-vrs-020-design.md

## Global constraints
- No unfinished SPS branch integration, original eye draws retained.
- No measured performance claims without matched valid hardware captures.
- No global runtime/registry/profile changes for VRS.
- Existing quad settings/features remain available.

## Review focus
- Invalid/stale gaze and asymmetric FOV must select bounded fixed focus.
- NVAPI failure and excluded render scopes must not leak shading state.
- App action sets and XR submission poses must remain intact.
- Old settings and unrelated child environment must not select experiments.
- Benchmark mode labels and no-focus metrics must reflect two-view rendering.

## Verification record

The complete LLVM-MinGW native/WARP/fake-runtime suite passed after the final
SSR naming fix. The launcher suite passed settings, launch environment, geometry,
benchmark, input, diagnostics and actual/simulated DPI layout checks. All four
PowerShell compatibility suites passed. The packaged ZIP was extracted and all
32 manifest hashes verified. MSVC was not available in this checkout's environment.

NVIDIA hardware probes verified moving full-rate focus, coarse peripheral
shading and restoration; ten consecutive final-code processes exited cleanly.
Review fixes cover cropped native-projection gaze mapping, failed-session gaze
cleanup, inactive quad-only controls and SSR bank name uniqueness.

LMU reached the Monza/Alpine offline scene with stereo VRS configured at 6312x2980,
rate 2x2, successful stereo submission and initialized gaze. An earlier live run
observed active gaze; the final integration smoke run primarily reported runtime
standby. This is not a completed awake-headset image-quality or matched performance
benchmark. No FPS/frametime gain is claimed; SSR quality and other providers still
need live validation.
